newsitem.title: USA: Computer Motion sets initial public offering.
newsitem.headline: Computer Motion sets initial public offering.

text.p: Computer Motion Inc said Thursday it had filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an initial public offering of 2.5 million shares of its common stock at an estimated price of between $13 and $15 a share.
The deal is being managed by Montgomery Securities and Piper Jaffray. The underwriters have an over-allotment option of up to 375,000 additional shares.
Computer Motion develops and markets proprietary robotic and computerized surgical systems.
